Indikator 12 evaluates critical clinical outcomes for patients with atrial fibrillation, focusing on severe bleeding complications and 1-year mortality rates across Danish regions and healthcare clusters. 

In the 2023 assessment of severe bleeding within one year of diagnosis, no hospital or region managed to meet the required clinical standard. The "Standard opfyldt" (Standard met) column remained at 0% across all evaluated entities, indicating a universal miss on this specific quality target [^src1]. Nationally, the proportion of patients experiencing severe bleeding was 3.1%, a slight improvement from 3.3% in 2020/21 [^src1]. However, local performance varied significantly. [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] emerged as a major outlier, recording the highest rate of severe bleeding at 6.0% (11 out of 183 patients), nearly double the national average [^src1]. Conversely, [[steno-diabetes-center|Steno Diabetes Center]] and Samsø Sundheds og Akuthus reported 0.0% bleeding rates, though their patient volumes were extremely low (5 and 7 patients, respectively) [^src1]. Among the larger regional units, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] reported a 3.4% rate, while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] recorded 3.0% [^src1]. 

The 2024 report shifts the focus to 1-year mortality rates across national, regional, and local health clusters ("sundhedsklynger"). Nationally, the 1-year mortality rate for Indikator 12 decreased to 12.5% in the current reporting year, down from 13.1% in both 2021/22 and 2020/21 [^src2]. Regional mortality rates were relatively tightly clustered, ranging from 11.9% in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] to 13.0% in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] [^src2]. At the cluster level, [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] recorded the highest mortality rate at 16.6%, a notable outlier compared to the national average [^src2]. On the other end of the spectrum, [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] achieved the lowest mortality rate at 9.2%, followed closely by [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] at 9.9% [^src2]. Some clusters demonstrated significant year-over-year improvements; for instance, [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] reduced its mortality rate from 12.4% in 2021/22 to 9.9% in the current year [^src2].
